nom: The Ordinary Volufiline 92% + Pal-Isoleucine 1% Plumping Serum

avis.titre: Works but the bottle design is horrible
avis.texte: This product does what it says it will do. It's not a miracle worker so don't expect your wrinkles to vanish but with consistent use I saw a difference. I was lazy and didn't get a new bottle for a few months and I can tell so it's not a product that has lasting effects when you discontinue use. That said the bottle dropper is horrific and needs to be improved. It either lets NOTHING out or 4 drops, there is no in between and you only need 1 drop, 2 max each time.

avis.titre: Good product, bad bottle. Ordinary- please improve!!
avis.texte: Desperately wish this product 1) was perhaps a touch larger for the price, and most importantly 2) had a dropper, roller, or other system for application. The bizarre plastic insert (much like an essential oil dropper bit) either rushes too much product out at once, or none at all. I'm tempted to try and funnel it into a click-up brush applicator, but at the price per ounce I worry about wasted product on the funnel or any accidental spills. It does feel oily/nonpolar to the touch as others have mentioned, but isn't unpleasant to me at all and is very compatible with massage and lymphatic drainage techniques like gua sha. It can sometimes tingle around the eyes especially, so don't be alarmed if this occurs- but definitely don't apply too heavily, because it will burn if it seeps across skin INTO the eyes. Product creates a noticeable difference pretty speedily for sunken areas of the face as well as lines and wrinkles (be it from aging or dynamic wrinkling from dehydration, stress, etc.). It absorbs well and I have had no issue with pilling when used with squalane and oil based moisturizers.

I've been using Volufiline morning and night in my skin care routine for 8 months now and I will say there has been a noticeable difference. It has definitely added more volume to my under eyes and my fine lines are far less noticeable. I definitely feel like it has made me look younger. It does take a while to see a difference but since I've been using it for 8 months now I want to leave a review and say that this product definitely works.

avis.titre: This works really well for me
avis.texte: This works so well for me. I don't have very deep wrinkles (11 lines and forehead). But this makes them disappear. I use it morning and night. It also seems to work well on my neck. It also plumps my lips.

I was absolutely influenced to buy this but it's just not right for me. It pills, no matter how long I wait after applying moisturizer. The product leaves a greasiness on my hands that doesn't easily wash off. I've been using for nearly three months and just don't see results.

This is odd stuff. It's a bit oily to apply though it absorbs very quickly so that's not a real issue. And it does have an effect on the places where I apply it, mostly around my lips and marionette lines. (I don't use it on my forehead; argiriline works better for that.) It doesn't provide major volume, but it does soften things somewhat and evens out the lines around my lips a bit. It's not exactly transformative but it does help, and helps over time. I know some people dismiss this as at best a temporary fix, but it does seem to have a longer lasting impact. There is some numbness, especially around the lips, and the delivery system is pretty awful; I can't imagine who would have thought that this dispenser bottle was a good idea, because it's not. Still, for all that the effect is minor and the dispenser is an irritant, I just bought my second bottle.

avis.titre: Does not work and bad bottle
avis.texte: I have been using this solution on the heavy bags under my eyes daily for six weeks and have seen absolutely no difference. The texture is not bad but the bottle is absolutely horrible. It's hard to get a drop out without spilling more than intended.

I'm 38 & have noticed loss of volume under my eyes. I've been using this nightly for 5 days under my eyes & I can already see significant plumpness & smoothing of fine lines. I'm shocked at my personal results & would highly recommend! To dispense, I put my ring finger over the stopper & give it a good shake. I do that several times until I'm satisfied with the amount I've put on, as it does dispense too much if i drop it out on the back of my hand. I'm using it on the deeper lines between my eyes & forehead & haven't noticed much difference there thus far, but I'm floored with the under eye difference The *only* con I've experienced is I have pretty oily skin & since the serume is oil based, I definitely can't use it in the am so I'm missing out on 2x daily application. Can't speak to how it behaves on dryer skin for morning use under makeup

This serum DID work for me. That is, I did see physical results. That being said, they are very subtle, and I was using the product at least twice a day for several weeks before I noticed a difference. It does burn a little and tingle when uou apply it, although over time I found I dont feel any tingling or burning anymore. This absolutely would not replace fillers. The results even when frequently used and consistent use are very mild. I only noticed a difference because I was looking closely. The bottle will probably last a long time, currently I've only gotten through less than a quarter of the bottle, but I assume that to maintain results you have to consistently use it every single day. (Much like lash serum).
According to the directions it says apply After moisturizer but on clean dry skin? Its confusing and doesnt seem to work

Im 35 years old and have noticed fat loss underneath my eyes. The area seems more hollowed out. I saw someone on tiktok state this product makes their orbital area look 60-70% and oddly enough that's the best way to describe how it improved the area. My orbital looks significantly and notably more full. Because the product is clumsy to disperse, I've been using the back of my hand. That area looks like it grew a small circular bump. It filled the small lines on my forehead and reduced the huge wrinkle between my eye brows (but obviously didnt make it disappear). The only con is that its super oily. It broke me out if I used it anywhere below that orbital are .

I got this with high hopes that it might help me but unfortunately I used it consistently as directed but nothing ever happened except my face would sting when I first applied it. By the time I figured out that it wasn't going to work it was already too late to return.
I had high hopes for this based on reviews, but I've seen absolutely no improvement after two weeks. I wanted it to work especially for my lips.
This plumps my lips. My marionette lines. Under my eyes. I love this stuff!

I started with this product in May! There's a noticeable difference on where I place the volufine. I follow instructions to the tee and put it on as a my last product after applying my moisturizer. It goes under my eyes, nabloids (outer nose), and forehead.

avis.titre: POTENT Less is More.. use pin prick amounts c below
avis.texte: Learning curve needed. Should come with insert. I used too much & caused my eleven lines to look deeper. LESS IS MORE with this product! You only need a microscopic pinprick fraction of a drop Stretch tap don't rub in circles.
I bought this due to all the hype and reviews. I used it for over 3 weeks and saw no results. I thought it was also to oily for my skin. Don't thinking I would purchase again

avis.titre: My sister told me about this product.
avis.texte: I used at night after my moisturizing, I like feel the oil on my face.
This product makes a huge difference in the depth of my wrinkles! Love it!

I gave this a try for the stubborn spot between my eyebrows along with crows feet and forehead lines. I really liked it and felt that it did help. Nothing can get rid of them completely, but I thought this did help plump those lines.
So far I like the product. It does seem to be gradually working plumping. Not a huge difference. It burns a little when I put it on.

avis.titre: Useless. Doesn't work at all. No changes to my skin or face
avis.texte: Useless. Doesn't work at all. No changes to my skin or face . Would not recommend

I've only been using this product for a little over a week so it's going to be awhile for long term benefits, but for my lips, right off the bat I noticed it smoothed them out and they stayed well moisturized. My lipliner went on the smoothest it has in years!

I am pleasantly surprised how this has plumped my under eyes. I had tried everything - due to hormones and i've been using it consistently for a couple weeks and I can totally tell the difference . I noticed after week 1. Naturally I was skeptical but I'm so glad I tried it because no amount of moisturizers and empty promises from other products worked. I recommend 100%

I am a lip filler girl, and I usually get my lips filled every 3-4 months but I cannot afford it anymore as it's pricey!!! So when I saw this could possible plump lips I wanted to try. I have officially gone through 2 bottles, putting it on my lips morning and night every day. I have not had filler since october, so coming up on 6 months. When I started using this less than 2 months ago, I was already wanting more filler but tried this instead. LET ME TELL YOU my lips look amazing and I think i can go months longer without filler. I will be buying this on repeat and it has become a part of my AM and PM routine!!!!!

You have to use it consistently as directed , i just drop it onto my fingertip and dab on the areas i want to plump . Ive been using it for my lips and undereye area and have especially seen a difference in lips.

I'm a black woman in my early-20's and I had fat removed from my face a couple years back that I greatly regret and have been trying to rebuild ever since. When I say I have tried everything, I mean everything. This product, in conjunction with the Exuviance Advance Total Correct Serum and HA Lifting Concentrate, has basically rebuilt my fat and restored my face to looking even better than before. I will continue using this, as each day does seem to get better with using it consistently. Definitely worth the investment. If you are considering getting filler and want to try a product that will actually work first and save you lots of money, go for this one of the Exuviance ones I mentioned above. Thanks, hope this helps!

For those who buy this, order roller balls for essential oil bottles look for the ones that fit 5mL and 15mL bottles and they fit perfect. Much more precise application and easier to control :) this product works amazing with consistency
This broke me out in the areas I focused on (cheeks for nasolabial folds). Unfortunately, for that reason, I am returning.

This product was affordable and works just ok, the problem I find is that I do not see any instructions on how to apply to the face. Uncap the bottle and not sure how to dispense. Do I use a cotton ball or my finger tip? A cotton ball seems to absorb the product when trying to apply,

I am only using this for my lips. It is subtle (which I like, I do not want to look like I got fillers), but makes such a huge difference in my overall look. Gets rid of the lines and makes them look slightly plumper. Works instantly. I put it on top of my lip balm and instantly plumps for about an hour. But, after applying it daily (and sometime twice a day), I now notice a consistent difference even when not using it (I still apply daily...but the first few days it seemed to wear off in an hour---but with consistent use of a week now, it is staying permanent (just use daily!) Really Love it!

I love this product. Have been using The Ordinary for years, and was very excited when i saw they were coming out with this! Just wanted to give a tip about the bottle/packaging that a lot of people are complaining about…you dont take off the plastic topper; shake the bottle with the lid on, and then when you take off the bottle lid, simply turn the bottle upside down (with the plastic topper still ON) and tap against your fingertips. Et Voila! Comes right out ! Hope that's helpful :o)
Please change the packaging. A rollerball could be a better option. The packaging is messy and wasteful.

avis.titre: Review after finishing the whole bottle
avis.texte: It took me about 2 months of (somewhat) consistent use to get through the bottle. Im sad that ive seen zero results. Ive been using it across some lines on my forehead. In the hollows under my eyes and around my lips for more fullness. I have seen zero results. It tingles a lot when i put it around my lips (no redness or anything) so i thought that was a good sign. But after comparing photos of when i first started using on my face to now, i dont see any difference. Im disappointed because reddit users swear by volufiline. They were mostly speaking of a french brand that first introduced this formula, so maybe its just this brand. Ive always had great results with this brand, so i was hopeful. Seems to work for others though! I have combo skin and im 36 years old.
Anazing product only 4 stars because the packaging is not good at all it waste so much product It needs a droper
I bought this for the first time because I was concerned about the signs of aging on my face. It plumps just the right amount, so I'll keep using it.

In just a few days I've noticed a difference in the areas I've applied this. As others have said, the packaging is bad. I pried off the plastic stopper and am just dipping a cotton swab in. I may still waste some product, but i have better control.

I've been using this product for about one week and it does seem to pump a bit under my eyes, everything I buy from the ordinary seems to be good so I will keep using it and review again in about a month! I also want to know how everyone gets products gifted to them from the ordinary?!?!?

I know the directions are a bit contradictory, but i decided to follow the brand's product video. Apply this after you've washed your face, moisturize your skin, and after the moisturizer is absorbed. It is said that product is able to be layered on top of the serum, but it is oily and takes a long time to absorb. A little goes a long way, but the packaging is awful and wastes a lot of product. It gives me nothing at all or 10x the amount i need. Ive been using for about a week, too soon to see results but decided to post now in case this is helpful.

I lost some weight in my face and the skin under my eyes got really hollow. With consistent use on targeted spots, I've noticed an improvement on skin thickness. It does burn if I use every day, so it's been more for use every other day or every couple of days. I hate the packaging, it makes no sense to use a toner stopper for such a tiny product, but the product itself works for skin thickness.

I'm still on first bottle so I'm still weighing in, it does seem to plump up the hollows in my cheeks that are common with older ladies, I absolutely hate the bottle, either doesn't work or comes out too much...is there a reason for this design? it takes me longer to fight with the bottle than to actually apply it

avis.titre: works but not a quick fix
avis.texte: after two months of usage twice a day, I started to see a difference in my undereye hallows and smile lines. its sublte but my undereyes look less sunken in and my smile lines have softened to a point of almost being unnoticeable. if you're patient and diligent, you'll see results. at 40, this is what I was hoping for. its not going to do what filler can achieve but i also dont want to go that route. I will be repurchasing.

I feel like im being punked reading the positive reviews. Ive been using as directed for close to a month & see zero difference. There is a slight, temporary plumping effect on lips( kind of like a stinging lip plumper) but nothing under the eye area, in the area of my nasolabial folds or fine lines.

I've only had and been using this for a week and my personal experience is that this is very strong for under eye usage. When they say moisturize before use please use your heaviest moisturizer and then put on an occlusive like petroleum jelly because this stuff is strong. I apply over my lip moisturizer and it instantly plumps and smooths lines. I don't know or even care if it will work on my face because the way it works on my lips is better than any lip plumper on the market and you only need one drop.
This comes in a bottle like essential oils come in. There is no dropper. Makes it a mess if prefer a dropper stick inside like mist serums duh!

been using for about a month now and there's definitely a difference in my facial creases! it works like a filler, smoothing over my aging face but keeping some of the cuter wrinkles that have graced my eyes and cheeks when I smile. only now, you can't see any creasing when my face is neutral - if that makes sense lol if you feel like your face is starting to have permanent creasing with age, this stuff turns back the clock! I love it! highly recommend

Yeah this works. Just summing it up for those that don't have time to read the rest of the review but for those that do: it Hecking works. I used it on my lips and parentheses and noticed more fullness in my parenthesis but more noticeable on my lips. Full transparency: there was a numbing feeling when i had it on my lips and no, I'm not allergic. Called my dr to make sure it wasn't that kind of reaction and they said there would be other signs and if i was still worried, i could bring it in for a proper allergy test. I trust my dr not to go that extreme and waste time and manpower for all that. I noticed longer plumpness from this than any lip pumping product I've ever tried. I'm not saying this is going to substitute for anyone considering Dr office solutions for lips or wrinkles, just saying this a less invasive but still effective and affordable route to take. FTR the numbing feeling was only on my lips, i didn't notice it on my face where my parenthesis are. The fullness effects lasted until I went to bed and I'm assuming either from my nighttime skincare routine or just time itself, it wore off by the time i woke up. Another note: i use retinal at night and only try new skincare products in my AM routine so as to not conflict or minimize the effects of retinal. So once absorbed, this lasted through chatting all day, eating drinking etc. The ordinary has never failed me and idk why I still waste money on luxury skincare brand products when ordinary is always more effecti
Not sure how I feel about this yet. Still too soon to tell but I like the way it feels. Ordinary products have not failed me yet!

Bought this product not having high expectations and was pleasantly suprised. The product is oily and does not come with a dropper. I've only used this product twice and there is already a difference under my eyes, and cheeks. I am 43 years old. It helped fill in my hollow under eyes which helped the dark circles, slightly lessen the wrinkles on my nasalabia folds and made my cheeks and lips more plump. I like how you can use this with most products.

to be fair, I dont really know how its suppose to be used. I have put it on... under my eyes, lips etc. I notice nothing. I have put more, I have put less, I have used it more often..... nothing. Nobody gifted this to me. I bought it. This is an honest review.

avis.titre: Conflicting directions on how to use
avis.texte: The packaging says to use on clean dry skin. The online description says to use after moisturizer. Which is it?
I didn't notice any changes in my skin/volume loss. I think it may have caused a small breakout on my cheek.

I mainly bought this to plump up my lips more (since I'm a certified chapped lipped girly) I've only been using it for about a week, twice a day, and I feel like I see a difference! not anything dramatic like a strong lip plumper or injections obviously, but I do think my lips look less shrinky-dinky. I pair this with The Ordinary lip balm, just put a few drops on my finger and dab it on top of the lip balm. Be aware that it DOES tingle!

I don't have sensitive skin, because at first it does give you a strange sensation, but it's not painful. I've been using it on my lips and they definitely feel more plump and hydrated. The product absorbs well, but it is a little oily, although that feeling doesn't bother me on my lips. complimentary from The Ordinary , gifted by The Ordinary

avis.titre: I love the results I'm seeing!
avis.texte: The Ordinary's Volufilin e 92% + Pal-Isoleucine 1% is the product to use if you have concerns about loss of volume and hydration in your skin. After using it a few times I can visibly see the difference in the areas which I have the most concern when it comes to loss of volume and fine lines, which are the hollows of my eyes, fine lines in my forehead and my naso labial folds. My skin also feels more hydrated and looks more plump. #gifted by the ordinary

So this volufiline is the first with this concentration AND being able to apply after moisturizer. That is huge…it's really an all in one great product. It is going to last forever because you only put it where you need it…not your whole face. This product is a must have and it's so much easier to prevent than repair!! Gifted by theordinary

Gifted by the ordinary. After using for a couple weeks now. I have had no burning or irritation. It's light and soaks in nicely. It doesn't leave me looking oily. I do notice some plumping especially around my nose. It's not life changing but I do hope with continued use it gets even better. It is very hydrating even in the cold dry weather.

#gifted by theordinary I've been trying the Volufiline 92% + Pal-Isoleucine 1% and was surprised by how quickly it melts into the skin. It gives a cushioned, bouncy feel and adds a healthier look to the areas I focus on. With steady use, I've noticed better softness and a gentle boost in volume that makes my skin look more refreshed overall. It fits easily into my routine and doesn't interfere with other products.

I received a complimentary from The Ordinary. The product feels a bit oily but it was quickly absorbed by my skin. It did have a warming sensation under the eyes, but not on my cheeks or smile lines. I've only used it for a week but it does leave my face feeling hydrated.

avis.titre: I will definitely add this product to my skincare routine
avis.texte: My biggest concern are my marionette lines and deep eyes. I applied every morning after my moisturizer on these areas of concern and after 4 days I noticed my eyes less deep and more plumpness around my marionette lines. Definitely will add to my skincare routine! gifted by theordinary

I've been using this product which was gifted by theordinary for the last 2 weeks under my eyes, on my smile lines and lips. It has an oily consistency so I only use it at nighttime, but I feel my skin looks more hydrated and plump in the morning. It's nothing drastic, but enough to keep using it nightly.
